exposure: Happiness of the mother-partner relationship during pregnancy
Happiness of the mother-partner relationship postpartum
cohort: 3006 women in the First Baby Study, a prospective study of the effect of mode of first delivery on subsequent childbearing
finding: Higher levels of maternal social support and happiness in the mother-partner relationship, both during pregnancy and postpartum, as well as high partner involvement in newborn care, were associated with lower rates of maternal-reported infant colic.
